create_persona_generator_protocol: create a class implementing the PersonaGenerator protocol with generate_diverse_persona_characteristics and generate_single_persona_memories methods
build_persona_initializer_component: build a PersonaInitializer component that runs two-stage persona generation and injects memories into agent memory banks
generate_persona_characteristics: call generate_diverse_persona_characteristics to produce diverse persona characteristics given an initial context and diversity axes
generate_persona_memories: call generate_single_persona_memories to generate formative memories and backstory episodes for a single persona
run_persona_initialization_pipeline: run the PersonaInitializer pre_act method to execute the full two-stage persona generation pipeline for all players
